newsitem.title: UK: BA up on Qantas optimism, break above 600p.
newsitem.headline: BA up on Qantas optimism, break above 600p.

text.p: LONDON, Nov 21 (Reuter ) - Shares in British Airways rose in a falling market on Thursday, helped by a break above 600p and reports Australian airline Qantas is confident of higher profits despite higher fuel prices, marketmakers said.

British Airways shares rose as high as 605-1/2p before easing back to 603-1/2p by 1237 GMT, up 10-1/2p on the day. Over 2.4 million shares had changed hands. The FTSE 100 share index was barely changed at the time.
"The 600p level is a positive signal for many people and also, this is a thin market with not too much stock around so the moves tend to be dramatic," one marketmaker said.
Others said BA shares were helped by reports that Qantas, in which BA owns a 25 percent stake, is looking to improve earnings despite higher fuel prices and softer markets.
